recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR work is needed for FHIR-15678 unless a future FHIR-I decision changes the broader ElementDefinition.path naming policy.
issue_request: FHIR-15678 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Change Request for STU3 asking FHIR-I to define special rules for logical-model element names and provide computable invariants: error-level checks for forbidden characters such as '/', whitespace, '.', and '#', plus warning-level checks for simple alphanumeric, letter-starting names that are safer for code generation.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 13886. Git-svn commit 1df3fff3b3d7a4d6ee306dae2e6fd6245d959abf, 'GF#15678 - element name constraint', added the original ElementDefinition.path/name error and warning invariant rows to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active datatype and maps the ElementDefinition type page to source/elementdefinition.html. Later Published FHIR-I issues refined the same invariant family: FHIR-17728 allowed [x], FHIR-19745 and FHIR-26306 fixed anchoring, length, FHIRPath, and Schematron details, and FHIR-38795/FHIR-38796 clarified the human descriptions and logical-model warning context. Those later decisions explain the current source shape.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml already contains eld-19 and eld-20, and source/elementdefinition.html describes the same ElementDefinition.path naming rules.
